import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
for i in [334115,334187,334206]:
 o=json.loads((p/f'corpus/{i}.jsonl').read_bytes());print(i,o['statement'])
allow=json.loads((p/'historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()); out=[]
protected=['formal','polynexus','crown','tournament','bunkbed','hat-','r395','code-loop','unit-acyclic','graph-square']
ids=[str(i) for i in json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']]
for s in allow:
 if any(t in s.lower() for t in protected):continue
 q=Path(s)
 if not q.is_file():continue
 b=q.read_bytes();text=b.decode();hits=[i for i in ids if i in text]
 out.append({'path':s,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'hits':hits})
 if hits:print('HISTORY MATCH',s,text)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'history-inventory.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
print('history eligible read',len(out),'matching',sum(bool(x['hits']) for x in out))
